SEARCH
Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.render.resolver

Interface EyeAttachmentResolver

All Superinterfaces:
ModelMemo.Resolver<net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel<?>,Attachment>
All Known Implementing Classes:
AdvancedModelBoxResolver, LLibraryResolver, RootModelResolver
public interface EyeAttachmentResolver extends ModelMemo.Resolver<net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel<?>,Attachment>
Strategy for getting from an entity model's base render pose into the animated space of a named attachment part, so eyes can be drawn relative to it.

Different model frameworks expose their part trees differently (see RootModelResolver, AdvancedModelBoxResolver, and LLibraryResolver); each converges on the same contract here. Implementations must use obfuscation-safe handles only — string part names walked from a stable entry point / positional root indices, never obfuscated field names.

The work splits in two. resolve(net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel<?>, java.lang.String) searches the model's part tree by string name and is the expensive half; toAttachmentSpace(com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.PoseStack, net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel<?>, java.lang.String, boolean) replays the Attachment it produced onto the pose and is the per-frame half. The split is what lets Resolvers.ATTACHMENTS memoize the search: a model is a singleton and a token names the same part within it forever.

  • Method Details

    • enumerateParts

      default List<String> enumerateParts(net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel<?> model)
      List selectable attachment tokens for this model, in a stable order (used by the part picker). Default: none (the resolver doesn't support enumeration / picker authoring).

    • canonicalToken

      default String canonicalToken(net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel<?> model, String storedToken)
      Translate a (possibly differently-spelled or partial) stored attach token into the canonical path token this resolver would enumerate for the same part — the single vocabulary the picker, HUD, and exported configs all speak. That is the full slash path (root/body/head), with a positional segment (#N) only where a part has no obfuscation-stable name. Returns the token unchanged when it can't be resolved to a part (so unknown tokens pass through untouched rather than being silently remapped).

      Default: identity (the resolver's enumeration vocabulary already matches stored tokens, e.g. named bones).

    • handles

      boolean handles(net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel<?> model)
      Whether this resolver knows how to walk the given model's part tree.

    • clearModelCache

      default void clearModelCache()
      Drop any per-model state this resolver caches. Called from Resolvers.clearCaches() when the models themselves are replaced. Default: the resolver keeps none.

    • normalize

      static String normalize(String s)
      Normalizes a single token/part-name segment so camelCase field names match snake_case child-map keys.

    • segments

      static List<String> segments(String token)
      Split a slash-delimited attach token into normalized, non-empty path segments. A bare name (no slash) yields a one-element list; null/blank yields an empty list. Each segment is normalize(java.lang.String)d, so "Body/leftHead" and "body/left_head" produce the same list.

    • pathMatches

      static boolean pathMatches(String storedToken, String candidatePath)
      Whether candidatePath ends with storedToken (a normalized suffix match over path segments). So a stored "head" matches a candidate "root/body/head", and a stored "body/head" matches it too while distinguishing two parts both named head under different parents. An empty stored token never matches (callers must supply a part).

    • resolve

      @Nullable Attachment resolve(net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel<?> model, String partToken)
      Find the part partToken names and return the transforms that reach it, or null when the model has no such part (an unknown token, or a model whose worn variant lacks it).

      The expensive half of the contract: a search of the model's part tree, matching each candidate path against the token. Called once per (model, token) — see Resolvers.ATTACHMENTS — so it may allocate and walk freely.

      Specified by:
      resolve in interface ModelMemo.Resolver<net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel<?>,Attachment>
      Parameters:
      partToken - the configured attachment token (a string part name, possibly camelCase)
      Returns:
      the resolved value, or null when the token names nothing in the model.

    • toAttachmentSpace

      default boolean toAttachmentSpace(com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.PoseStack poseStack, net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel<?> model, String partToken, boolean young)
      Move poseStack into the named part's current (this-frame, post-animation) space, first reproducing any whole-model transform the model applies outside its part tree (ThirdPartyModelWraps). The caller is responsible for pushPose()/popPose() around this call.
      Parameters:
      partToken - the configured attachment token (a string part name, possibly camelCase)
      young - the render state's baby flag, which selects the model's age branch
      Returns:
      true if the part was found and the pose moved; false otherwise (caller should skip drawing for this head)
